description:
FieldCamp AI Dispatcher brings your field-service operations into ChatGPT. Connect your FieldCamp
workspace and ChatGPT can see your live jobs, technicians, daily schedule, and dispatch performance,
then act on them: create jobs, run AI dispatch optimization across your team, and accept or reject the
AI's suggested assignments — all from chat. Built for dispatchers and operations teams who want to plan
and adjust their day conversationally. Read tools only retrieve data; write tools (create job, run
dispatch, accept/reject) make explicit, reviewable changes, each annotated with read/write hints.

defaultPrompt: Show today's dispatch schedule grouped by technician
Create a job for a water-heater repair at 123 Main St tomorrow morning and run AI dispatch
Which jobs couldn't be assigned today, and why? Suggest fixes.
